AXSP20.src: DOC-CAT p.59: Axios Pro 20W black 3000K = 1600 lm, beam 15/24/38/60 selectable, CRI>80. No polar curve published -> single Gaussian at the chosen optic, 0.91 peak factor (CALC/EST).

REGA12.src: EST: lumens 850-950 (TISVA COB downlights run 79-81 lm/W: Orrin 13W 1050 lm, Galaxy Pro 12W 960 lm, GVO 12W 950 lm; CRI>90 chips give ~10% less). Beam 38 deg inferred from code pattern ...338... Shape = FIT to Orrin 13W (DOC-CAT p.39) as the deep-recessed analogue; soft-shape case uses the Orrin 7.5W fit.

REGA7.src: EST: 500-560 lm (Orrin 7.5W = 600 lm at CRI80). Shape = FIT to Orrin 7.5W polar (peak ~1227 cd/klm) + table (p.37).

BOLT12.src: EST: Rio SF 12W surface cylinder (TISVA, same family) is quoted >75 lm/W -> ~900 lm; beam 36 deg assumed (typical surface COB cylinder).

SPOTLIT.src: EST: 2W PC downlighter, 120 deg (DOC-PL); ~70 lm/W -> 140 lm (+/-30).

LS3K.src: EST: Lumelace 10 W/m 120 LED/m 3000K (DOC-CAT p.75 gives W/m only). Typical 2835 strips 80-110 lm/W -> 800-1100 lm/m; 0.70 transmission for the opal profile diffuser.

BULB.src: DOC-OTH: Philips Hue White Ambiance / IKEA Tradfri E27 = 806 lm (ACCEPTED design value 2026-10-02; the earlier 470 lm E14 assumption is kept as a sensitivity case); 0.75 transmission for an opal glass globe (EST).

LAMP.src: EST: decor floor lamp with an 800 lm bulb, fabric shade (60% out, mostly up/down).
